chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation:
 The Constitution
 of the Ruling
 Evil

**
¶1:**
 Consider
 the ruling
 love
 of self,
 which
 gov
erns every
 form of falsity and evil in
 the unregenerate mind
. Five genera
 of evil compose
 its
 entire nature
, corresponding to the five fundamental
 kinds of spiritual privation that
 constitute the whole
 realm
 of what
 is opposed
 to heaven
.

**¶2:** Its
 in
most intention
 —
 that
 which gov
erns all else
 — is the love
 of dominion over others,
 and
 this arises from self-love.
 Its
 power
 to
 elevate thought
 and extend
 reasoning
 is
 intellectual pride, formed
 after
 the likeness of self
-derived intelligence.
 Its capacity
 to act and to
 accomplish in
 the world is obsc
ure compulsion, fash
ioned after
 the lik
eness of those
 states
 that dar
ken and
 conf
use the understanding.
 Its interior
 appetite is consuming falsity, formed
 after the likeness of the complete
 privation of good. Its lowest and
 most external
 faculty is immersion
 in sens
ory knowing
 turned
 to
 evil ends
,
 belonging to the
 realm
 of fals
ity at
 the natural level.
 These
 five genera
 compose
 the whole selfhood of evil,
 and they arise
 from the five fundamental kinds of spiritual opposition
 to
 the Divine
.

**¶3:** When
 this
 ruling evil w
ills,
 it operates
 through obsc
ure compulsion
, moving
 by
 means
 of confused
 and
 dark
ened states
. When
 it w
ills otherwise
, it acts with
 the
 burning urgency of self-love,
 driving
 forward
 on
 every
 power
 of hand
 and foot together
. When it wills, it elev
ates itself through intellectual pride and rationalization
, so
aring above others
 as
 self
-derived intelligence does
. When it wills, it pl
unges down
ward and
 im
merses itself entirely
 in falsities,
 as
 those
 do
 who d
well in false
 persu
asions
. And
 again
, when it wills, it advances
 by
 consuming
 falsity alone
, dra
gging itself through complete spiritual darkness as
 those
 do who are utt
erly de
pr
ived of good.
 All
 five
 modes
 of operation
 belong
 to it
.


**¶4:**
 There are also
 three further
 qualities belonging
 to this
 ruling evil.

**¶5
:** The
 first: [the
 text
 is
 broken
 here
;
 what
 remains
 suggests
 the
 sh
eer
 force or
 comp
uls
ive energy
 of its
 subordin
ate evils,
 but
 the
 correspondence
 cannot
 be completed
 with
 confidence
.]


**¶6:** The second
: It
 poss
esses the
 art of persuasive
 fals
ity.
 When it wills, it calls
 upon its
 own
 nature
 to conc
eal itself,
 and it
 h
ides its
 true quality
 even from the
 lesser
 evils and
 fals
ities that
 serve
 it
. When
 it wills, it reveals
 itself to them and strikes with
 destroying
 force
 through
 the
 power
 of its persu
asion. Whatever
 expression
 of falsity it ut
ters in
 that moment carries with
 it the full
 force
 of spiritual destruction.

**¶
7:** The third: The
 self
hood of this
 evil
 is hard
ened beyond
 penet
ration. The
 sharp
 and
 cutting powers
 of its own subordin
ate evils cannot breach
 it. No exterior
 truth
,
 however
 firm
, and
 no natural good,
 however strong
, can equal it
 in
 resistance
;
 they
 cannot destroy it from
 without
,
 because it was constit
uted and
 formed
 from the obstinate and
 u
nyielding will of the proprium
 itself —
 that
 self
-
orig
inating love
 which is the mother
 of all evils and all
 falsities.

**¶8
:** There are yet
 three further
 qualities belonging
 to it
.

**¶9:** When
 it wills, its self
-love blazes forth, and
 its entire nature
 becomes as
 one
 burning
 mass
 of the
 desire
 to dom
inate.


**¶10:** When
 it wills otherwise
, it sends
 forth the
 opposite
: the
 total
 absence of charity, and
 its
 entire
 nature freezes into cold
 indifference and
 contem
pt,
 like a form
 made
 wholly
 of what
 is lif
eless and bar
ren.

**¶11:**
 The third:
 Whenever its subordin
ate evils and
 falsities stand
 present
 and active before it, it perceives
 and
 understands them;
 for whatever aff
ection
 exists
 within
 them it reads
,
 both
 their
 interior
 desire
 and their out
ward expression
,
 so
 long as they remain
 present before
 it. But
 when they withdraw and
 remove
 themselves from its
 immediate
 sphere
, it underst
ands nothing of what
 is in them
. For
 there is no genuine
 life in this ruling
 evil what
soever —
 no
 love
 of
 good
, no perception
 of truth
.
 What
 appears
 as its life
 is only the v
enom of w
rath that
 shows
 itself upon
 its face,
 and the
 terror
 it
 projects
 before
 itself
.
 It
 knows
 only
 destruction
, and destruction
 is all
 that stands
 before it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Consider the ruler, the leader of all the powers of darkness. Now, five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of darkness.

Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of darkness.

Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [like the children of the] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [go upon] four [feet,] on his hands and feet [at once,] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of darkness. These five shapes are in him.
Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.

The second: Shall a [power challenge him, he shall overcome it by] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [wreak magic] by it.
Again, there are three others in him.
When he wants, his fire shall blaze, and his entire body be made like the [body of] fire.
Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [body of] snow.

The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever ex]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [power approach him, it shall find only] destruction that is establ[ished be]fore him.

The first: [His

emble with fear before him.]

The third: His body is strong, a[1] [ ... ] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [ ... ]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
